description: This Java class defines the StoreLandingDescription entity, which encapsulates properties related to the landing page description for a store, such as title, description, keywords, homepage content, and associated language.

classes.name: StoreLandingDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing store landing page metadata such as title, description, keywords, homepage content, and language.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the store landing page.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the store landing page.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords for the store landing page.

methods.name: getKeywords
methods.description: Retrieves the keywords for the store landing page.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the store landing page.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the store landing page.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Associates a language object with this store landing description.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the language object associated with this store landing description.
